page_title: SAS 3-0 VER | Sassuolo v Verona 20/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Verona will take a corner kick.
90+3' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes out of play. Verona are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Flag goes up against M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+1' Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for an infringement.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' It's time for a substitution. Pedro Felipe (Sassuolo) comes on in place of Sebastian Walukiewicz.
87' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 6:3.
85' Al Musrati (Verona) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
83' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
82' Here is a change. Kieron Bowie is going off and Paolo Sammarco gives the last tactical orders to Ioan Vermesan (Verona).
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Abdou Harroui will be replaced by Tomas Suslov (Verona).
81' The Sassuolo players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
78' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
77' What a big chance! Daniel Mosquera (Verona) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.
75' 8:11 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
73' We are about to witness a subsitution. Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo) for Ismael Kone.
73' Substitution. Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) has come on for Armand Lauriente.
73' That's the end of the game for Domagoj Bradaric, who is replaced by Daniel Oyegoke (Verona).
72' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti is replaced by M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo).
72' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Amin Sarr.

72' What a poor attempt! Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
71' Sassuolo keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.

69' Amin Sarr (Verona) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Arijanet Muric.
69' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
68' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The linesman makes the right call and Sassuolo will have a corner.
68' Sassuolo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
68' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
67' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. Corner kick. Sassuolo will have an opportunity.

66' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
64' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

62' 3 - 0 What a GOAL! A quick turnover allows Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) to mount a one-man counter attack and ends with him scoring with a precise shot from close in that easily beats the keeper. That makes it 3:0.
61' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) commits a rough foul. Livio Marinelli stops the game and makes a call.
60' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
58' Martin Frese (Verona) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
57' Verona are seeing far more of the ball now.
55' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) pounces on a cross into the middle of the box, but plants his header well wide of the right post.
54' Kieron Bowie (Verona) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross.
53' The ball possession is 44:56.
51' Livio Marinelli shows a yellow card to Al Musrati (Verona) for his blatant foul.
50' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner with a short pass.
48' Verona hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 0 Goal! Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 2:0.

44' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) steps up to the penalty spot. He attempts to confuse the goalkeeper by stopping in the middle of his run up and sends the ball low to the middle of the target, but Lorenzo Montipo keeps his cool to thwart him.
44' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
43' Cheikh Niasse (Verona) makes a slide tackle, but referee Livio Marinelli blows for a foul. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Sassuolo.
42' Verona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
40' 1 - 0 Goal! Armand Lauriente plays it to Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Lorenzo Montipo. 1:0.
39' Andrias Edmundsson (Verona) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
36' Here comes a substitution. Filippo Romagna (Sassuolo) is brought on as a substitute for Woyo Coulibaly.
34' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 0:3.
32' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
30' Sassuolo are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
27' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) is adjudged offside.
26' Andrias Edmundsson (Verona) jumps into a tackle and Livio Marinelli signals a foul.
24' Martin Frese (Verona) is flagged for offside.
22' Livio Marinelli has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kieron Bowie (Verona).
20' What a great touch by Kieron Bowie (Verona) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
18' The free kick is taken by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona), but ball is cleared.
17' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) was quite harsh and Livio Marinelli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Verona.
16' Amin Sarr (Verona) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Verona.
14' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 55:45.
12' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
10' It looks like Kieron Bowie (Verona) saw red with that tackle. Livio Marinelli won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
8' Rough tackle by Martin Frese (Verona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
3' Sassuolo hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
Verona will kick-off.
